## 📊 Technical Implementation Details

### Shared Components Architecture:
```
@codai/shared-ui/
├── components/
│   ├── layout/
│   │   ├── AppShell.tsx ✅          # Universal app wrapper
│   │   ├── Header.tsx ✅             # Responsive header
│   │   └── Footer.tsx ✅             # Ecosystem footer
│   ├── pages/
│   │   ├── LandingPage.tsx ✅        # Customizable landing
│   │   └── DashboardPage.tsx ✅      # Feature-rich dashboard
│   └── ui/
│       ├── Button.tsx ✅             # Core button component
│       ├── Input.tsx ✅              # Input component
│       └── Card.tsx ✅               # Card component
├── contexts/
│   └── AuthProvider.tsx ✅          # Authentication context
└── middleware/
    └── auth.ts ✅                   # Route protection
```

### Authentication Flow:
```
1. User visits app → Middleware checks auth status
2. Non-authenticated → Landing page (AppShell variant="landing")
3. Authenticated → Dashboard (AppShell variant="dashboard")
4. Login/Signup → AuthProvider handles state
5. Protected routes → Middleware redirects if needed
```

### App Template Structure:
```
apps/<app-name>/
├── app/
│   ├── layout.tsx ✅                # AuthProvider wrapper
│   ├── page.tsx ✅                  # Landing page
│   ├── dashboard/page.tsx ✅        # Dashboard
│   ├── login/page.tsx               # Login form
│   └── signup/page.tsx              # Signup form
└── middleware.ts ✅                 # Route protection
```

## 🔧 Development Workflow

### Quick Start Any App:
```bash
# 1. Apply template (if not done)
cd scripts
node generate-app-template.cjs <app-name>

# 2. Install dependencies  
cd ../apps/<app-name>
pnpm install

# 3. Start development
pnpm dev

# 4. Visit in browser
http://localhost:3000 (or assigned port)
```

### Build Shared Packages:
```bash
# Rebuild shared components
pnpm build --filter @codai/shared-ui

# Build translations
pnpm build --filter @codai/translations
```
